answers.constraints: Bounded bug fix for issues 74 and 76 (items 2 and 5) only: guidance and ordering in chough next and status; no stage gate or schema or output-key change and no new dependency and no extra native read; issue 75 and items 1 3 4 of issue 76 are out of scope
